checkpoints.label: Xenium human lung (raw counts)
checkpoints.description: 11,898 cells x 289 genes as the instrument counted them, with cell boundaries over the morphology image, and no analysis yet: find clusters, compare groups, look for spatial patterns.

credit.changes: Read with spatialdata-io and saved with its raw counts, its cell boundaries and the morphology image from half resolution down; the transcripts were left out.

checkpoints.label: Xenium human pancreas
checkpoints.description: 122,678 cells with their segmentation boundaries over an H&E image, already clustered. Saved without its expression matrix, to stay small.

credit.source: FFPE Human Pancreas with Xenium Multimodal Cell Segmentation
credit.changes: Analyzed by Spatial Data Studio's workflow (quality control, normalization, PCA, UMAP, Leiden clusters, cellular neighborhoods); the image was reduced and the expression matrix left out.
